sections.title: Your Body Speaks First
sections.content: Before you utter a single word, your body has already sent a message. Open body language signals confidence, honesty, and authority. Closed body language signals defensiveness and nervousness.
bullets: Open palms signal honesty and engagement
Your gestures should match and amplify your words

sections.title: The Speaker's Box
sections.content: The Speaker's Box is an imaginary rectangle from your waist to your chest and roughly shoulder-width apart. Keep your hands within this box during your speech for controlled, confident gestures.
bullets: Hands above the chest look frantic or aggressive
Hands below the waist look weak or uncertain
Inside the box = confident and controlled

sections.title: Open vs. Closed
sections.good: Speaker A stands with feet shoulder-width apart, hands resting at the Speaker's Box, using open palm gestures toward the audience when making key points.
sections.bad: Speaker B stands with arms crossed, hands in pockets, shifting weight from foot to foot.
sections.explanation: Speaker A projects confidence. Speaker B looks defensive and uncomfortable.

sections.instruction: Putting your hands in your pockets during a speech signals relaxation to the audience.
sections.feedback: Hands in pockets signals nervousness or disinterest. It also restricts gesturing.

sections.q: What is the 'Speaker's Box' in public speaking?
options: The area from your waist to your chest where controlled gestures should occur
The space on stage you are allowed to walk
The volume range of your voice
sections.explain: The Speaker's Box is the optimal zone for gestures between waist and chest.

sections.statement: Crossed arms show you are thinking deeply about the argument.
sections.feedback: Crossed arms are read as defensive or closed off, regardless of your actual mental state.

questions.q: Why do open palm gestures build trust with an audience?
options: They are evolutionarily associated with honesty
They help you project your voice
questions.feedback: Open palms are an ancient signal of 'I am holding no weapon.'
